Class RuntimeLimits

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.RuntimeLimits
public final class RuntimeLimits extends Object
Runtime constants shared by analysis and the current UNO R4 backend.

    • STRING_SLOT_CAPACITY_BYTES

      public static final int STRING_SLOT_CAPACITY_BYTES
      Size (bytes, including the NUL terminator) of each slot in the rotating pool backing every runtime String (String.valueOf, Json.getString(byte[],int,String), StringBuilder.toString()). A value that would need >= this bytes panics rather than truncating or overflowing — see the backends' runtimeStringHelpers().
